omposition import CoreRig, assert_core_wiring

async def check():
    repo = Path.cwd()
    git = Git(SubprocessExec(), env={'PATH': os.environ['PATH']}, timeout=30)
    base = await git.rev_parse(repo, 'HEAD')
    assert await git.status_porcelain(repo) == ''
    observed = []
    def observe(frame, event, arg):
        if frame.f_code is triage.triage_pass.__code__ and event == 'return':
            observed.append(frame.f_locals['driver'])
    with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='serve-custody-') as directory:
        rig = CoreRig(Path(directory))
        assert_core_wiring(rig)
        llm = FakeLLM([])
        lock = Lockfile(rig.checkout.config.state_dir, instance_id='custody-probe', clock=rig.time)
        lock.acquire()
        previous = sys.getprofile()
        try:
            sys.setprofile(observe)
            assert await triage.triage_pass(rig.checkout, llm) == []
        finally:
            sys.setprofile(previous)
            lock.release()
        assert len(observed) == 1
        driver = observed[0]
        assert driver.journal is not rig.checkout.journal
        assert driver.effects._journal is driver.journal
        assert driver.effects._journal is not rig.checkout.journal
        assert llm.requests == [] and rig.exec.calls == []
        print('Untouched base:', base)
        print('Real CoreRig triage Driver and Effects use a separate Journal')
        print('No model calls, external work, or writer replacement')
        driver.journal.close()
        rig.journal.close()
    assert await git.rev_parse(repo, 'HEAD') == base
    assert await git.status_porcelain(repo) == ''
    print('HEAD unchanged; working tree clean; no implementation commit')

asyncio.run(check())
